booth-split.name: Booth Split
booth-split.description: Using the roster and the POS or book export, list tickets and totals in two piles: house employees versus booth renters.

closeout.name: Closeout
closeout.description: From the POS export, list sales types, tenders, tips, voids, and gift-card activity.

days-book.name: Days Book
days-book.description: Build tomorrow's or today's book from their booking export.

gift-card-recon.name: Gift Card Recon
gift-card-recon.description: From their gift-card export, list sales, redemptions, and remaining balances using last-four or internal IDs only.

menu-vs-book.name: Menu Vs Book
menu-vs-book.description: Compare services on the day's book to the menu file.

no-show-list.name: No Show List
no-show-list.description: From the book export and their policy file, list cancelled and no-show rows.

reminder-list.name: Reminder List
reminder-list.description: Build a list of guests due a confirmation or reminder from their export. They send the messages.

retail-count.name: Retail Count
retail-count.description: From their count sheet, list on-hand, flag SKUs below par if the sheet has par, and keep retail off the backbar column.

waitlist-gaps.name: Waitlist Gaps
waitlist-gaps.description: List open slots the hours file says are workable, plus waitlist names from their export.
